entities.name: Genuin Monetize
entities.description: Genuin's layered monetization product offering in-feed and in-stream ad formats for partner brands, with both direct-sold and programmatic demand paths.

entities.name: Genuin SDK
entities.description: The client SDK that powers Genuin's video carousels and feeds embedded on partner websites and apps; renders both organic content and ads.

entities.name: Genuin Video Player
entities.description: The in-app video player that supports in-stream linear video ads (pre-roll, mid-roll, post-roll) and renders feed content.

entities.name: Genuin Video Server
entities.description: Genuin's backend video server that serves direct-sold Sponsored Takeovers and Sponsored Posts into feed slots.

entities.name: Brand Control Center
entities.description: Genuin's dashboard for partner brands to manage Monetize Presets, ad waterfall priority, frequency/density settings, sponsorships, and placements.

entities.name: BCC Analytics
entities.description: Aggregate ad activity reporting within BCC for direct-sold Sponsored Posts and Takeovers, covering impressions, engagement rates, and revenue summaries.

entities.name: Monetize Preset
entities.description: Strategic control layer in BCC that defines which ad types are active for a placement, their waterfall priority, and frequency/behavior parameters.

entities.name: Premium Preset
entities.description: System default preset that enables sponsored content only (Takeover or Sponsored Posts) and disables all programmatic and in-stream ads.

entities.name: Aggressive Preset
entities.description: System default preset for maximum revenue: in-feed enabled at start slot 2 / repeat 2 and in-stream enabled across all positions.

entities.name: Balanced Preset
entities.description: Recommended MCC default preset with in-feed start 2 / repeat 4 and in-stream limited to mid-roll only to avoid back-to-back ads.

entities.name: Conservative In-Stream Only Preset
entities.description: System default preset that disables in-feed ads and runs in-stream only when users expand to full-screen player view.

entities.name: Conservative In-Feed Only Preset
entities.description: System default preset with in-feed at start 3 / repeat 5 and in-stream disabled so content videos play uninterrupted.

entities.name: Sponsored Takeover
entities.description: Highest-priority direct-sold in-feed format that converts the first n feed slots into a continuous brand-sponsored experience served by the Genuin Video Server.

entities.name: Sponsored Post
entities.description: Direct-sold in-feed card containing brand-sponsored video content placed into calculated frequency-based ad slots and served by the Genuin Video Server.

entities.name: Programmatic In-Feed Video Ad
entities.description: Programmatic video creative served via Google's IMA SDK and fulfilled by the Aniview ad server, rendered as a video card with a blue CTA bar in place of engagement icons.

entities.name: Programmatic In-Feed Native Ad
entities.description: Programmatic native static card (headline, image, brand logo, description, CTA) served via GPT.js and fulfilled by the Aniview ad server.

entities.name: Programmatic In-Feed Display Ad
entities.description: Programmatic standard banner (image or HTML5) served via GPT.js and Aniview, occupying the full feed card slot as a static visual unit.

entities.name: In-Stream Video Ad
entities.description: Linear VAST/VMAP video ads served programmatically via IMA SDK and Aniview at pre-roll, mid-roll, or post-roll positions inside the Genuin video player.

entities.name: House Fallback
entities.description: Mandatory always-on Genuin-served content that fills empty in-feed slots when all programmatic demand sources return no fill.

entities.name: In-Feed Waterfall
entities.description: Sequential resolution model where higher-priority ad types (Takeover, Sponsored Post, Programmatic Video/Native/Display, House) are attempted in order to fill an in-feed slot.

entities.name: Aniview
entities.description: Third-party ad server that fulfills Genuin's programmatic in-feed (video/native/display) and in-stream demand and exposes brand safety controls and reporting.

entities.name: Aniview Dashboard
entities.description: Aniview's reporting dashboard providing granular programmatic reporting on impressions, fill rate, CPM, and revenue broken down by channel/placement.

entities.name: IMA SDK
entities.description: Google's Interactive Media Ads SDK used to render programmatic in-feed video ads and in-stream VAST/VMAP ads inside the Genuin video player.

entities.name: GPT.js
entities.description: Google Publisher Tag JavaScript library used to render in-feed native and display programmatic ads as static card creatives.

entities.name: VAST
entities.description: IAB Video Ad Serving Template standard used for in-stream and programmatic in-feed video ad creatives and click/tracking URLs on Genuin.

entities.name: VMAP
entities.description: IAB Video Multiple Ad Playlist standard used by the Genuin player for one ad request per pre/mid/post-roll break (no podding).

entities.name: McClatchy
entities.description: Publisher partner brand for whom this MCC edition of the Monetize guide is written; example placements include Kansas City Star and other McClatchy news properties.

entities.name: IAB
entities.description: Standards body whose impression measurement and skippability guidelines (ads beyond 15 seconds must be skippable) Genuin's Monetize platform aligns with.

entities.name: Partner Brands
entities.description: The advertiser/publisher brands that activate Genuin Monetize and operate the BCC dashboard; the primary audience for this guide.

entities.name: Consumer Brands
entities.description: Consumer-facing advertiser brands that embed Genuin video experiences and run ads through the Monetize platform.

entities.name: Retailer Brands
entities.description: Retailer advertiser brands that embed Genuin video experiences on their owned-and-operated properties.

entities.name: Media Brands
entities.description: Media and publisher brands (e.g., McClatchy titles, Woman's World, US Weekly) that use Genuin to embed video feeds and monetize via ads.

relationships.description: Sponsored Takeover is the highest-priority in-feed format within the Genuin Monetize framework.
Sponsored Posts are the primary direct-sold in-feed format within Genuin Monetize.
Programmatic in-feed video is the third-priority in-feed format in the Monetize waterfall.
Programmatic in-feed native is the fourth-priority in-feed format in the Monetize waterfall.
Programmatic in-feed display is the fifth-priority in-feed format in the Monetize waterfall.
In-stream linear video ads are a core Monetize format that plays inside the Genuin video player.
House/Fallback is the mandatory last layer of the Monetize in-feed waterfall.
The in-feed waterfall is the resolution model that drives ad selection within Genuin Monetize.
Takeover content is uploaded by the partner brand and served by the Genuin Video Server.
Sponsored Posts are distributed by the Genuin Video Server into calculated ad slots.
In-feed programmatic video ads render through Google's IMA SDK.
In-feed programmatic native ads render through GPT.js.
In-feed programmatic display banners render through GPT.js.
In-stream ads are delivered to the player via the IMA SDK.
In-stream creatives are trafficked using VAST 2.0/3.0/4.0 with optional VPAID JS.
Pre/mid/post-roll breaks are scheduled via VMAP, one ad request per break.
IMA SDK requests are fulfilled by the Aniview ad server for both in-feed and in-stream video demand.
GPT.js native and display requests are fulfilled by the Aniview ad server.
Aniview serves and brand-safety-filters programmatic in-feed video demand.
Aniview is the ad server that fulfills programmatic in-stream VAST/VMAP demand.
The Aniview Dashboard is the reporting surface within the Aniview platform.
Monetize Presets are configured and assigned to placements inside the BCC dashboard.
BCC Analytics is the aggregate reporting module inside BCC for direct-sold ad activity.
Premium is one of the five read-only system default Monetize Presets.
Aggressive is a system default Monetize Preset optimized for maximum revenue.
Balanced is the default system Monetize Preset recommended as the MCC starting point.
Conservative In-Stream Only is a system default Monetize Preset.
Conservative In-Feed Only is a system default Monetize Preset.
The Genuin SDK initializes and powers the Genuin video player and feed rendering.
The Monetize guide and platform are explicitly intended for Genuin partner brands.
Genuin Monetize is offered to consumer brands embedding video carousels and feeds.
Genuin Monetize is offered to retailer brands embedding video carousels and feeds.
Genuin Monetize is offered to media brands embedding video carousels and feeds, including McClatchy titles.
McClatchy is the partner publisher activating the Monetize MCC Edition described in this guide.
Monetize impression counting and skippability rules align with IAB measurement standards.
VAST is an IAB-defined video ad serving standard used by the Monetize platform.
VMAP is an IAB-defined ad break playlist standard used by the Genuin player.
